notes:
Prospect profile: mid-market B2B SaaS (product analytics + in-app help). Evaluating Redwood as primary inference provider for user-facing chat and doc search. Key themes and shorthand below.

- Primary ask: EU data residency (customers in Germany, France). Cannot accept customer PII leaving EU per contract.
- Current plan: start on Hosted API (fast time-to-value) -> pilot -> Dedicated reserved pool in eu-central (Frankfurt) for production.
- Latency targets: sub-120ms 95th for chat from major EU metro nodes; throughput ~150 rps during peak; cost sensitivity moderate — want predictable committed cost.
- Multi-region routing: Valora wants canary route to us-east for failover but must avoid sending any EU customer data outside EU unless anonymized. Legal pushed back on any fallback that sends identifiable data.
- Quote from Head of Product: "We need low jitter in EU — users notice 200ms+ lag and drop messages."
- SE notes: Suggest host EU primary + dedicated reserved capacity; implement routing policy that only falls back to US for non-PII fallback traffic or after explicit masking step. Also propose prefix KV cache to reduce cost.
- Security/Compliance: require SSO/SAML, org-level audit logs, 12-month retention, KMS integration for model keys, contractual data residency clause.
- POC details requested: sample QPS, payload sizes, representative prompt sets, SLOs for 95th/99th latency. They want a week-long bench POC in eu-central and a short stress run with dedicated pool sizing.
- Pricing conversation: finance asks for committed monthly price for Dedicated 4xA10G-equivalent reserved in eu-central with burst headroom and clear per-token overage rates. Interested in temp pilot credits on Hosted to compare.
- Blockers: legal redlines (data residency language), internal infra budget for network egress, procurement timelines (sign by 2026-04).
- Next steps: send tailored SOW + Dedicated pricing options, provide clear doc on routing rules + data residency controls, schedule POC kickoff for week of 2026-03-24.

Misc quick bits:
- Internal contact: Pedro (Head of Infra) — concerned about cross-region NATS latency; wants routing determinism.
- Suggested SE action: prepare two config examples: 1) Hosted -> Dedicated lift path with eu-only processing, 2) Dedicated with private control plane (customer-managed VPC) for full on-prem-like residency.
- Jira ticket RI-3217 opened to capture POC infra requirements.

Stated decision criteria: EU residency confirmation, predictable latency under 120ms p95, committed pricing that meets finance band, legal sign-off on residency clause.
